versions.content: SwBaseType BaseType is used to specify the basic data type level. AUTOSAR uses the meta-class SwBaseType which is derived from the abstract class BaseType due to other use cases for BaseType in ASAM HDO.

SwBaseType BaseType is used to specify the basic data type level. AUTOSAR uses the meta-class SwBaseType which is derived from the abstract class BaseType due to other use cases for BaseType in ASAM HDO.

Applicability of SwBaseType for the definition of data types BaseType is used to contribute low-level aspects to the definition of an Implemen- tationDataType . Consequently, the information carried by SwBaseType is used to generate the corresponding C-code typedefs in case the attribute BaseTypeDirect- Definition . nativeDeclaration exists at the “leaves” of data type definitions.
